text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGED: API gateway error rate spike detected in us-west-1 (502/504 surge) — alert threshold crossed (5m). Pager: Eric (oncall).

Eric (oncall): seeing it, joining. pinging SRE channel.

Jules (sre): on it. first check: is this localized to us-west-1 or global?

Devon (eng): telemetry shows 95% of 502s originating from the edge-fanout group behind apigw-proxy-3. Link to quick dashboard: https://internal/telemetry/apigw?range=15m

Amy (sre): confirmed high 502 ratio and elevated latency before the 502s. Looks like upstream timeouts cascade into gateway 502s.

Eric (oncall): customer-impact? any high-traffic clients affected?

Ana (product): a handful of PLG customers in us-west are showing errors on health checks, some API calls failing. Need an estimated impact window.

Devon (eng): rolling logs from apigw-proxy-3: 
```
[2026-03-15T16:05:12Z] upstream timeout (10s) -> 504
[2026-03-15T16:05:12Z] backend connection reset -> 502
[... repeated pattern ...]
```
Looks like backend pods in cluster backend-west-2 are hitting conn resets around 16:04.

Jules (sre): check recent deploys/rollouts. Any config or infra changes in last 30m?

Devon (eng): there was a canary deploy of edge-rate-limiter policy ~14m ago (edge-rate-limiter v2). I rolled back canary after anomalies started showing but it may have coincided.

Amy (sre): good call. Could be the rate-limiter causing connection churn to backends. Also TLS renegotiation errors in some logs.

Eric (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) Pause canary & force previous policy on affected proxies, 2) divert traffic away from apigw-proxy-3 to apigw-proxy-1/2, 3) scale backend-west-2 temporarily, 4) enable circuit-breaker for noisy upstreams. Who can execute 1 and 2 now?

Devon (eng): I can force policy rollback. Running: 
```
kubectl -n edge apply -f edge-policy-v1.yaml --record
kubectl rollout restart ds/apigw-proxy-3
```

Devon (eng): policy rollback applied to apigw-proxy-3. Restart in progress.

infra-bot: Routing weight update requested: set apigw-proxy-3 -> 0.2, apigw-proxy-1 -> 0.4, apigw-proxy-2 -> 0.4. Change submitted by Devon.

Jules (sre): scaling backend-west-2 from 6 -> 12 replicas now, and putting aggressive liveness probe grace to avoid thrashing.

Amy (sre): enabling temporary circuit-breaker rule for upstream service 'backend-api' to fail-fast after 3 consecutive errors: 
```
circuit-breaker: { maxRetries: 0, errorThreshold: 3, backoff: 10s }
```
Applied.

Eric (oncall): monitoring for improvement. Any sign of errors decreasing?

Devon (eng): early telemetry: 2m after rollback, 502 rate dropped ~60% on apigw-proxy-3, overall error rate down ~45%. Latency tail also improving.

Ana (product): reaching out to top 3 affected customers with initial note: "We're aware of transient API errors in us-west, mitigation underway; we'll follow up with root cause and ETA."

Jules (sre): still seeing some 502s but they're sparse and align with remainders of backend pod restarts. Suggest keeping circuit-breaker for 30m and leave routing weights adjusted for 10m before gradual normalization.

Amy (sre): quick note: DNS TTL for backend-west-2 was 60s, but we saw a spike of SYN_RETRIES from some edge nodes pointing to a possible mid-tier NAT exhaustion. I'm opening a follow-up ticket for infra network team.

Eric (oncall): good call. Action items: Devon to run postmortem checklist, Jules to own oncall timeline and rollback verification, Amy to file network/NAT ticket with traces, Ana to follow up with customers.

Devon (eng): capturing timeline and logs now. Will include `kubectl describe` outputs and full curl repro steps. Example repro we used: 
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.com/v1/predict -d '{"prompt":"x"}'
```
Got 502 with tcp reset in several attempts before rollback.

incident-bot: Incident escalated -> postmortem-required, P1 created: INC-2026-0315-01.

Ana (product): sending status update to customers now. :email:

Eric (oncall): leaving this thread open for 30m monitoring. If error rate returns to baseline, we'll close and run RCA offline. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

Jules (sre): temporary mitigation left in place. Will coordinate with infra for NAT pool check and with edge team for a deeper config audit.

Amy (sre): note for postmortem: correlate TLS renegotiation logs + rate-limiter rollback + NAT metrics.

Devon (eng): noted. I'll include commit SHAs and canary config diffs.

Eric (oncall): logging final state: rollback applied, routing weights adjusted, backend scaled, circuit-breakers on. Error rate down to acceptable SLOs. Moving to monitoring stage.

incident-bot: Incident marked as stabilized at 4309877800 (approx).

Devon (eng): follow-up: schedule 1hr scrub meeting at 17:30 PT to go over RCA and next steps.

Ana (product): will prepare customer post-incident summary draft.

Jules (sre): thanks team.
